items.headline: D'Souza seeks inquiry into MCC's unaccounted ₹1.34 crore expenditure
items.blurb: Mangaluru South MLA D Vedavyasa Kamath asked the government to order a probe into ₹1.34 crore in unaccounted Mangaluru City Corporation spending flagged in audit reports, demanding accountability from the council and administration.
items.why_channel: ₹1.34 crore MCC audit probe — accountability with a concrete rupee hook for city taxpayers.

items.headline: Mangaluru gets second Vande Bharat Express train
items.blurb: Prime Minister Narendra Modi flagged off the second Vande Bharat Express for Mangaluru on 17 October 2026 on the Honavar–Mangaluru route via Udupi, with officials saying the service will cut travel time and boost tourism along the Konkan coast.
items.why_channel: Second Vande Bharat with PM flag-off date — commute/tourism infra with high share value.

items.headline: Bantwal to get ₹50 crore Smart Town project
items.blurb: Chief Minister D K Shivakumar announced a ₹50 crore Smart Town project for Bantwal with underground drainage, smart streetlights and a modern bus stand, targeting completion in 36 months.
items.why_channel: ₹50 cr Smart Town + 36-month deadline — classic Coastal Katte infra conversion story.

items.headline: Govt. all set to start work on airport international terminal, says Mangaluru MP
items.blurb: Mangaluru International Airport secured designation for expanded international operations with direct Dubai and Doha services announced, with airport officials expecting higher passenger and cargo traffic.
items.why_channel: Airport international terminal + expanded intl ops — jobs, travel and Mangaluru economy.

items.headline: 8 of 32 lakes in Dakshina Kannada contaminated: KSPCB survey
items.blurb: The pollution control board survey named eight Dakshina Kannada lakes as contaminated from sewage and solid waste, urging MCC and gram panchayats to prepare restoration plans.
items.why_channel: Eight DK lakes contaminated — public health/environment stakes across the coast.
